test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If y varies directly with x, and y = 61 when x = 42, find y when x = 54 (consider integral value).
solution:
**Given:**

y varies directly with x,

y = 61 when x = 42,

**Calculations:**

According to the question

y/x = 61/42

⇒ y/54 = 61/42

⇒ y = (61 × 54)/42

⇒ y = 3294/42 = 78.4 ≈ 78

**∴ The value of y will be 78.**
